     if[not code in key totals;totals[code]:0;volumes[code]:()!();order[code]:(`$())]
     totals[code]+:units i;peaks[code]:peaks[code]|units i
     if[not shift in key volumes code;volumes[code][shift]:0;order[code],:shift]
     volumes[code][shift]+:units i;i+:1]
   ks:key totals;rows:();i:0

     ksordered:key volumes code;best:first ksordered;bestv:volumes[code][first ksordered];j:0

     rows,:enlist `station`records`total_units`peak_units`top_shift!(string code;count order code;totals[code];peaks[code];string best)]
     if[(count order code)>=min_records;
       ksordered:key volumes code;best:first ksordered;bestv:volumes[code][first ksordered];j:0
